title: NgRx Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this NgRx course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: What does an action type describe?
options: The size of an HTML heading
questions.explanation: An action is a named message about something that happened. NgRx action creators make those messages in a consistent shape.

questions.question: How should this action creator be called?
questions.explanation: props describes values carried by an action. A reducer can read those values when it handles the event.

questions.question: What should this reducer return?
options: A mutation of the old object only
questions.explanation: A reducer takes the old state and an action and returns the next state. It should not change the old object directly.

questions.question: Which root key holds this reducer's state?
questions.explanation: provideStore connects reducer functions to root state keys. Angular can then inject a Store service into components.

questions.question: What should a selector do?
options: Return a useful result from state
questions.explanation: A selector is a function that chooses a useful part of state. createSelector can remember its last input and result.

questions.question: How is this selected signal read?
questions.explanation: Store.selectSignal gives an Angular signal for a selected value. The template reads the signal by calling it.

questions.question: Which call sends the action?
options: bookRead without calling or dispatching it
questions.explanation: A component can dispatch an action in response to a user action. The reducer remains responsible for changing shared state.

questions.question: Which creator comes from the event Add Book?
options: reading["Add Book"] as the public creator
questions.explanation: An action group keeps related event creators together. NgRx derives creator names from the event labels.

questions.question: Why separate effects from reducers?
options: To keep outside work apart from state calculations
To make reducers fetch every file directly
questions.explanation: An effect listens for actions and can return new actions after outside work. Reducers can stay focused on state changes.

questions.question: What does the entities object provide?
options: A sorted HTML table by itself
questions.explanation: A list with ids can be stored as an id array plus a lookup object. This makes finding one record direct and avoids duplicate copies.

questions.question: Which helper applies this SignalStore update?
questions.explanation: SignalStore is another NgRx way to organise state using Angular signals. Methods can call patchState to update a small part.

questions.question: Why check before.count as well?
options: To count how many test files exist
To ensure the original state was not changed
questions.explanation: A reducer can be tested without opening the page. Give it a known state and action, then compare the result.
